$comment: The enterprise shape. Same repository, same factory; only the autonomy column moves. Who owns which paths, what checks them, and how much freedom an agent has there. A path no target claims fails the build rather than being guessed at.

contracts.why: One definition three services are built against. A change here is never local, so it is proposed and never landed unattended.

ingest.why: Stores runs and stages. Wrong data is visible and recoverable, so an agent may finish work here on its own.

budget.why: Refused, and protected as well, so the run stops at the boundary rather than producing a plan nobody may act on.

console.why: Display only. It computes nothing, so the worst outcome is a page that reads badly, which a reviewer sees immediately.

repo.why: Workspace wiring and the factory configuration decide what every other rule means. An agent editing these could widen its own permissions, so it may not.
